fieldNotes.facility: Niagara Bottling Jupiter, 15832 Corporate Rd N, in the Palm Beach Park of Commerce. ~409,486 sq ft, operates 24/7, produces private-label bottled water. Confirmed via web search and satellite/Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: A canopied gatehouse / checkpoint structure is visible at the NW access road where it enters the secured yard (satellite z20). The entire property is enclosed by continuous chain-link perimeter fencing, clearly visible in Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Satellite z20 shows a small canopied booth structure beside the gate on the access road - consistent with a manned guard shack.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous dock face along the south building face with two rows of trailers (backed in plus a drop row); estimate ~75 doors, firmly 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Heavy trailer drop yard south of the docks with a full second/third row of parked trailers without tractors; firmly 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows visible in the south yard, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site sits in a semi-rural industrial park surrounded by woodland; flagged uncertain - cellular coverage likely adequate given proximity to I-95 corridor.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~355m N-S x ~310m E-W); ~60 acres.
